successCriteria.description: The policy module exposes a `createPolicyService()` factory that returns an `IPolicyService` instance wired with `PgLeavePolicyRepository` and a `LeaveTypeService` constructed with `PgLeaveTypeRepository`.
`createPolicyService` is exported from the policy module public entry point (`src/modules/policy/index.ts`) alongside all existing exports.
`npm run build` completes cleanly with no TypeScript or lint errors after the change.

constraints: Only `src/modules/policy/policy.service.ts` and `src/modules/policy/index.ts` may be modified; no other module or file is changed in this phase.
The `PolicyService` class, its constructor signature, and its runtime behaviour must remain unchanged; the factory is additive only.
The factory must construct `PolicyService` with `PgLeavePolicyRepository` and `LeaveTypeService` (constructed with `PgLeaveTypeRepository`), matching the architecture-confirmed dependency wiring.
outOfScope: Any change to the `PolicyService` class, its constructor, its methods, or its validation/runtime behaviour.
Modification of any module other than `policy` (e.g. leave-type, shared, db) or any file outside the two in-scope files.
Introducing dependency-injection containers, configuration-driven wiring, or any composition mechanism beyond the single factory function.

entityInvariants.invariant: Each invocation returns a new, fully-wired `IPolicyService` instance whose repository is `PgLeavePolicyRepository` and whose leave-type service is `LeaveTypeService` backed by `PgLeaveTypeRepository`.
Its constructor continues to accept `IPolicyRepository` and `ILeaveTypeService` and its existing methods/validation semantics are preserved unchanged.

interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Synchronous factory; returns a ready-to-use service instance and throws no errors under normal construction.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The factory must reuse the existing `PolicyService` constructor signature (IPolicyRepository, ILeaveTypeService) and the existing `IPolicyService` interface without altering them.

The factory must import `PgLeavePolicyRepository` from the policy repository module and `LeaveTypeService`/`PgLeaveTypeRepository` from the leave-type public entry point, matching the existing export surface.
The new export must be added to the policy public entry point without removing or renaming any existing export.

integrationPoints.why: Supplies `LeaveTypeService` and `PgLeaveTypeRepository` for the factory's dependency wiring (policy -> leave-type edge).
Supplies `PgLeavePolicyRepository` for the factory's repository dependency.
